purpose: Independent mixed Sobol reference follow-up on 3 selected existing evaluation graphs

reference_search.stopping_rule: Complete all 512 new starts per graph; no quality-driven stopping or automatic extension.
reference_search.scope: Only the declared 3 existing evaluation graphs. Preserve the full244 graph library, training roles, old references and evaluation records.
reference_search.interpretation: Targeted post hoc reference improvement with independently generated starts. Scrambled Sobol points within a replica are not independent Bernoulli samples. Known evaluation scores diagnose gaps only.
